meta.title: Version control panel
meta.description: Adds a version control tab to the right Sidebar for Git and Jujutsu repositories: working changes with file diffs, plus commit history with a lane graph and commit details. Browsing is read-only apart from Sync, branch and tag actions, and commit actions: branch and tag menus check out, rename, delete, merge, rebase, push, delete, or push refs; the commit menu creates tags and branches, checks out, cherry-picks, reverts, drops, merges, rebases, and resets at a commit. A remote-branch badge creates a tracking local branch, deletes the branch on its remote, merges it, or pulls it into the current branch. Conflicting writes are aborted; reset Hard discards index and working changes only after that mode is chosen. It never stages, force-pushes, edits conflicts, or creates a remote branch. Jujutsu may snapshot the working copy while reading.
